subtitle: The same HP=20 moment becomes a heal
synopsis: This replay isolates the S1 step. FlashLite-S1-RC has a reasoning-and-action format, but no explicit HP survival rule. At the same HP=20 danger point where S0 attacked and died, S1 uses POTION, survives two more low-HP checks, and wins. The lesson is narrow and concrete: asking for structured reasoning changed the decision at the critical moment.

highlights.label: HP=10 - second potion keeps it alive
